title: An Election
author: John Scalzi
note: conf=0.85; Verified: "An Election" is a standalone humorous short story by John Scalzi, presented by Subterranean Press/Subterranean Online and published free on Scalzi's blog Whatever on November 1, 2010 (an election-themed piece released ahead of the US midterms). Scalzi's own "Creative Sampler" page lists it as a standalone short story, not as part of any book series. Plot: a human runs for city council in a district where humans are a minority among aliens. It is NOT part of Old Man's War, and although some reader reviews note a tonal similarity to The Android's Dream (and one Goodreads reviewer loosely calls it the "Third District universe"), no publisher or bibliographic source identifies a real named series containing this title. Therefore series = null. Author metadata "Scalzi" expanded to John Scalzi.
